subject: [PATCH v2 04/10] mm/madvise: factor the cold and pageout folio split

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the code in madvise_lru_pmd_entry() to extract a new function, madvise_lru_split_folio(), which splits a locked and referenced folio into two separate folios. The original function is simplified by calling this new function instead of duplicating the same sequence of operations. This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves code maintainability and reduces duplication.
